name: test_security_headers_present
statusMessage:
XFAIL saucedemo.com (static GitHub Pages hosting) sends none of the standard security response headers -- verified live via curl -I, not something fixable from this framework

AssertionError: None of the expected security headers are present: ['content-security-policy', 'strict-transport-security', 'x-content-type-options', 'x-frame-options']
assert ({'content-security-policy', 'strict-transport-security', 'x-content-type-options', 'x-frame-options'} & {'accept-ranges', 'access-control-allow-origin', 'age', 'cache-control', 'connection', 'content-encoding', ...})
